bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for the greater Minnesota business development public infrastructure grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the greater Minnesota business development public infrastructure grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.431. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for the greater Minnesota business development public infrastructure grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the greater Minnesota business development public infrastructure grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.431.
additions: $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for the greater Minnesota business development public infrastructure grant program under Minnesota Statutes, section 116J.431.
